name: LiteRT Browser Numerical Parity Gate (FP32 vs WebGPU/WASM)
description: Verifies in-browser LiteRT.js (WebGPU / WASM fp16) numerical fidelity against the official PyTorch FP32 golden reference fixtures (gate_rows_s256 & gate_rows_td_s256), measuring argmax parity % and max |Δp|.
